Other potential mediating factors include a combination of anabolic resistance, chronic low-grade systemic inflammation, compromised satellite cell function, reduced angiogenesis, and blunted ribosome biogenesis. That said, older adults can and do see robust muscle growth after performing regimented progressive resistance training protocols. Hypertrophic gains in excess of 20% are routinely seen in this population, and increases are noted in both Type I and Type II muscle fibers (7).
